metadata.description: Free JidoSeal skill: check a folder of Markdown docs against OKF v0.2 with a local scanner and fix the missing frontmatter.

plugins.name: jidoseal
plugins.description: Check a folder of Markdown docs against OKF v0.2 and JidoSeal-defined Bronze/Silver/Gold frontmatter tiers (not ISO certification) with the local jidoseal-mcp scanner; the skill then helps you fill the missing fields and rescan. The scan runs on your machine; the README lists what it writes and what it sends.
